edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as creator, megatron owner and initial balance holder in the constructor.
_msgSender returns msg.sender.
SetBurnAddress relies on _owner/_msgSender state but lacks the onlyOwner modifier, so the ownership write is not caller-restricted.
transferOwnership is gated by onlyOwner which compares _owner with _msgSender().
msg.sender reaches _transfer as sender/recipient context for flag updates.
approve passes _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as spender for the allowance deduction.
_approve compares owner against creator and _msgSender() paths influence allowances.
transfer sends _msgSender() tokens.
block.timestamp (now) is hashed to derive the pseudo-random outcome in randomly().
randomly() decides quatkum[recipient], controlling the transfer branch and bypass conditions in _transfer.
Keccak result is truncated mod 100 into the screen local used as the random outcome.
_transfer performs SafeMath sub/add on balances on a randomized execution path.
_mint adds to _totalSupply and the recipient balance.
_burn subtracts from the account balance and _totalSupply.
SetBurnAddress writes _owner without an owner check, producing the ownership hijack unsafe operation.
_approve may overwrite the requested allowance with the constant 1234 based on the quatkum flag.
_transfer reads and writes megatron flags for recipient and sender.
_transfer randomizes and propagates quatkum flags.
_transfer mutates _balances for sender and recipient.
_transfer enforces require(amount < elephant) for non-megatron senders.
_approve writes the computed allowance into _allowances.
_approve reads quatkum[owner] to decide between 1234 and the requested amount.
_approve can whitelist the spender in megatron on the creator branch.
_approve flips the keyboard one-shot switch on the creator branch.
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
_burn decreases the target account balance.
FruitBowl calls _mint for _msgSender().
CheckTheAddress writes megatron[spender].
CheckTheAddress writes quatkum[spender].
SetBurnAddress assigns picture into _owner, transferring all onlyOwner privileges.
transferOwnership delegates to the internal _transferOwnership.
_transferOwnership replaces _owner with newOwner.
renounceOwnership zeroes _owner, permanently disabling onlyOwner functionality.
transfer delegates the balance movement to _transfer.
transferFrom first calls _transfer for the token movement.
approve delegates to _approve.
increaseAllowance computes the new value and calls _approve.
decreaseAllowance computes the reduced value and calls _approve.
_burnFrom calls _burn before adjusting the allowance.
_burnFrom calls _approve to deduct the spender allowance.
_transfer internally invokes randomly(), a timestamp-seeded pseudo-randomness oracle, to set quatkum.
Constructor credits _balances[msg.sender] with the full supply.
Constructor records creator = msg.sender.
Constructor sets megatron[msg.sender] = true.
Constructor sets quatkum[creator] = false.
Constructor assigns the fixed _totalSupply of 6000000000000000.
Constructor derives elephant = _totalSupply / 800 and copies it into opera.
BurnOptimusPrime lets the owner overwrite the elephant transfer cap.
ViewTheTaxi reads _totalSupply.
ViewTheTaxi copies _totalSupply into the tempval local.
randomly increments the saslaisgood state counter used as part of the seed.
_approve stores the possibly overridden value in the tok local.
transferFrom reads _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] before subtracting.
allowance view returns the nested _allowances mapping value.
_transfer uses the recipient parameter for flag checks and the balance credit.
_transfer uses the amount parameter in the elephant cap check and balance math.
_transfer uses the sender parameter for zero-address and flag checks.
_mint adds the amount parameter to supply and balance.
_mint credits the account parameter.
